## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one concern.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated, and they pass locally.
- [ ] `.proto` files are unchanged, or the generated code is regenerated and the contract change is called out above.
- [ ] A decision or incident worth recording is added to `docs/decisions.jsonl`.

- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real user data are included.
